description: Notification sent to student when a decision is reached on their misconduct case
subject: Academic Misconduct Case Decision - $case_id
body:
Dear $student_name,

The Academic Misconduct Panel has reached a decision regarding your case.

CASE DETAILS
─────────────────────────────────
Case ID: $case_id
Violation Type: $violation_type
Course: $course

PANEL DECISION
─────────────────────────────────
Ruling: $ruling
Case Status: $new_status
$rationale_section
─────────────────────────────────

If you wish to appeal this decision, you must submit a written appeal within 10 business days to the Academic Appeals Committee.

For questions regarding this decision or the appeals process, please contact the Academic Integrity Office.

Regards,
Academic Misconduct Panel
University Administration
